name: Galaxy Girls: Starlight Blossoms Bloom Brightest
source:
One day you wake up on a spaceship, with several other women, each one given a different job on board ship, doctor, engineer and you as Captain.

Can you complete the mission that has been forced upon you... And save humanity.

[From [url=https://dharker.studio/games/#/galaxygirls/]official website[/url]]
translation:
一天，你在一艘太空船上醒來，身邊還有幾名女性。她們各自負責船上的不同工作，有人是醫師，有人是工程師，而你是船長。

你能完成強加於身的任務……拯救人類嗎？

（來源：[url=https://dharker.studio/games/#/galaxygirls/]官方網站[/url]）
